name: LMeterX API and LLM Load Testing
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source self-hosted load-testing platform for LLM inference, HTTP APIs, A2A and MCP services; no software quota or expiration.
watch_out: Requires own Docker/Kubernetes compute (at least 4 GB free RAM and 5 GB disk for quick start), MySQL and metrics services. Load generation and tested cloud LLM/API endpoints can incur provider usage charges; no free hosted compute or model tokens included. Secure default credentials before production exposure.
